sources.citation: Purba, Theodorus T., Yacobus Paidi & Bartolomeus Kainakainu. 1997. Morfologi Bahasa Ormu. Jakarta: Pusat Pembinaan dan Pengembangan Bahasa, Departemen Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan. xv+363 pp.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: a digital copy exists, HathiTrust search-only
sources.note: Nothing. No phonology chapter; sec. 1.5 'Sistem Ejaan yang Dipakai' (book p.6) and sec. 2.1 (pp.8-9) only restate the phoneme inventory (5 vowels, 20 consonants, /x/ allophony) from Asani et al. 1987 'Fonologi Bahasa Ormu'. Full-book scanned a full-text search for stress/accent tekanan/aksen/stress/suprasegmental/nada/intonasi returns no prosodic statement ('suprafiks' appears once in the list of research aims, p.5, never discussed).
